description: Experience powerful sound wherever you go with the HAMMER Smash 2.0 Portable Bluetooth Speaker. Designed for music lovers who enjoy quality audio on the move, this compact speaker delivers 10W powerful sound with deep bass, creating an immersive listening experience for music and entertainment. Powered by Bluetooth v6.0, the HAMMER Smash 2.0 offers stable wireless connectivity with compatible devices, making it easy to connect and enjoy your favourite music. With up to 6 hours of playback at 50% volume, it is ideal for indoor entertainment, outdoor outings, travel, or casual gatherings. Enjoy versatile playback options with Bluetooth, USB Drive, TF Card, and FM Radio support, giving you the freedom to listen to your music the way you prefer. With True Wireless Stereo (TWS) support, you can pair two compatible Smash 2.0 speakers to create a wider and more immersive stereo sound experience. Bring energy to every beat with multi-color LED lighting effects, while the built-in carry handle makes the speaker easy to carry wherever you go.
